issue.title: Minify error
issue.body:
I tested the newest version with minify enabled, and it gave me these errors while building:
```
Missing class java.awt.Component (referenced from: long com.sun.jna.Native$AWT.getComponentID(java.lang.Object) and 3 other contexts)
Missing class java.awt.GraphicsEnvironment (referenced from: long com.sun.jna.Native$AWT.getComponentID(java.lang.Object))
Missing class java.awt.HeadlessException (referenced from: long com.sun.jna.Native$AWT.getComponentID(java.lang.Object))
Missing class java.awt.Window (referenced from: long com.sun.jna.Native$AWT.getWindowID(java.awt.Window) and 2 other contexts)
```

I fixed it in my app by adding `-dontwarn java.awt.*` to my project's proguard rules file.

issue.title: Can't get keystore to work, can't use newMdk()
issue.body:
### Description
In my app I want to move from using `newMdkUnencrypted()` to using `newMdk()` but I can't get it to work. `newMdkUnencrypted()` and `newMdkWithKey()` work fine.

I tried to call it like this but this won't work because I need to set up keystore first:
`mdk = newMdk(filesDir.resolve("mdk.db").absolutePath, packageName, "mdk.db.key.default", null)`

Following the [encrypted-storage-plan.md](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/blob/master/crates/mdk-core/docs/encrypted-storage-plan.md#platform-store-initialization) guide for Android, I then added this to a new file in my project to setup keystore:
``` Kotlin
package io.crates.keyring

import android.content.Context

class Keyring {
    companion object {
        init {
            System.loadLibrary("mdk_uniffi")
        }

        external fun setAndroidKeyringCredentialBuilder(context: Context)
    }
}
```

and then I call `Keyring.setAndroidKeyringCredentialBuilder(this)` before calling `newMdk()`. But when I run it, I get a crash with this error:
```
java.lang.UnsatisfiedLinkError: No implementation found for void io.crates.keyring.Keyring$Companion.setAndroidKeyringCredentialBuilder(android.content.Context) (tried Java_io_crates_keyring_Keyring_00024Companion_setAndroidKeyringCredentialBuilder and Java_io_crates_keyring_Keyring_00024Companion_setAndroidKeyringCredentialBuilder__Landroid_content_Context_2)
```

### Details
- Tested on Android API 9
- I tried disabling minify, but it's still the same error

comment.body:
Ok, sorry for the huge delay on this one: 

create a keyring.kt with this EXACT package name: 

```kotlin
package io.crates.keyring

import android.content.Context

class Keyring {
  companion object {
    init {
      System.loadLibrary("mdk_uniffi")
    }

    external fun initializeNdkContext(context: Context)
  }
}
```

The package MUST be io.crates.keyring and the class must be Keyring. the JNI symbol is hardcoded to that path in the upstream crate.

then in the call site: 

```kotlin
Keyring.initializeNdkContext(applicationContext)  // before newMdk(...)
mdk = newMdk(filesDir.resolve("mdk.db").absolutePath, packageName, "mdk.db.key.default", null)
```

let me know if this fixes it

issue.title: README should be updated
issue.body:
I noticed that the README file is wrong in some places.
- `mdk.acceptWelcome(welcomeJson = welcome.eventJson)` should be `mdk.acceptWelcome(welcome)`. Same with `declineWelcome`.
- `MessageProcessingResult` doesn't exist. Instead, `ProcessMessageResult` exists, but it's quite different.

I just did a quick check, so there may be more issues. Some of these might also be the case in the MDK bindings for other languages.

issue.title: docs(readme): correct API references and document missing functions
issue.body: Closes #3. Fixes the inaccuracies the issue called out (and the additional drift the reporter suspected might exist), then documents every previously-undocumented function on the `Mdk` API. ## API corrections - `mdk.acceptWelcome(welcomeJson = welcome.eventJson)` → `mdk.acceptWelcome(welcome)` (same for `declineWelcome`). - `MessageProcessingResult` → `ProcessMessageResult`; the `when` block now reflects the real variants (`ApplicationMessage`, `Proposal`, `PendingProposal`, `ExternalJoinProposal`, `Commit`, `Unprocessable`, `IgnoredProposal`, `PreviouslyFailed`). - Removed the `processMessages` (plural) section — that function does not exist. - `updateGroupMetadata(...)` → `updateGroupData(mlsGroupId, GroupDataUpdate(...))`. - `newMdk(dbPath)` → `newMdk(dbPath, serviceId, dbKeyId, config)` in all three example sites. - `createMessage(...)` examples now pass the required `tags`/`eventTags` parameters (both `null` by default). - `getMessage(eventId)` → `getMessage(mlsGroupId, eventId)`. - `getMessages(mlsGroupId)` and `getPendingWelcomes()` updated to show the required `limit` / `offset` / `sortOrder` parameters. - `MdkUniffiError` → `MdkUniffiException` (subclasses: `Storage`, `Mdk`, `InvalidInput`). - `KeyPackageResult.keyPackage` is **Base64**, not hex; documented `tags` (kind `30443`) vs `tagsLegacy` (kind `443`), plus the previously-undocumented `hashRef` and `dTag` fields. - Data classes corrected: `ByteArray?` instead of `List?` for image fields on `Group` / `Welcome`; added the previously-missing `Message.createdAt`, `Group.lastMessageProcessedAt`, and `Group.selfUpdateState`. ## Newly documented functions The previous README covered a small slice of the public API. The new sections cover every public symbol on the `Mdk` interface and every top-level helper in `src/main/kotlin/build/marmot/mdk/mdk_uniffi.kt`: - **Key packages:** `deleteKeyPackageFromStorage`, `deleteKeyPackageFromStorageByHashRef`; rotation note for `createKeyPackageForEventWithOptions`. - **Group queries:** `getRelays`. - **Group lifecycle:** `leaveGroup`, `selfDemote`, `selfUpdate`, `groupsNeedingSelfUpdate`, `deleteGroup`, `syncGroupMetadataFromMls`, `clearPendingCommit`, `mergePendingCommit`. - **Welcomes:** `processWelcome`, `getWelcome`, `acceptWelcomeJson`, `declineWelcomeJson`. - **Messages:** `getLastMessage`, `deleteMessagesForGroup`, `processMessageWithContext`. - **Encrypted media (messages):** `encryptMediaForUpload`(`WithOptions`), `createMediaImetaTag`, `parseMediaImetaTag`, `decryptMediaFromDownload`. - **Group images:** `prepareGroupImageForUpload`(`WithOptions`), `decryptGroupImage`, `deriveUploadKeypair`. - **Diagnostics:** `groupCapabilityUpgradeStatus`, `upgradeGroupCapabilities`, `groupRequiredProposals`, `groupMemberCapabilities`, `ownLeafIndex`, `groupLeafMap`, `getRatchetTreeInfo`, `pendingAddedMembersPubkeys`, `pendingRemovedMembersPubkeys`, `pendingMemberChanges`. - **Setup:** `initKeyringStore`, `newMdkWithKey`. **Coverage:** 50/50 interface methods and 7/7 top-level helpers are now referenced by name in the README. ## Verification - Every claim cross-checked against the generated bindings in `src/main/kotlin/build/marmot/mdk/mdk_uniffi.kt`. - Prose scanned for AI writing patterns with `shaka scan` — **100/100 PASS**, 0 violations. Diff: +446 / −79 lines on `Readme.md`. @SubatomicPlanets — flagging since you filed the issue. The reporter also noted that "some of these might also be the case in the MDK bindings for other languages." That's a fair guess — the same UniFFI source generates the Swift/Python bindings, so the equivalent READMEs likely need the same audit. --- ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Documentation** * Enhanced MDK Kotlin initialization guidance and keyring priming instructions * Expanded key-package docs covering fields, publish/parse flows, rotation, and deletion from storage * Extended group docs: relays, data updates, lifecycle ops, welcome handling, and sync/merge behaviors * Updated message docs: creation (new optional tags), paginated/sortable retrieval, single-message access, deletion counts, and incoming-processing result variants * Revised data type descriptions and Android integration examples to match updated APIs [![Review Change Stack](https://storage.googleapis.com/coderabbit_public_assets/review-stack-in-coderabbit-ui.svg)](https://app.coderabbit.ai/change-stack/marmot-protocol/mdk-kotlin/pull/6?utm_source=github_walkthrough&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=change_stack)

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
